notes: This portable C++ TCK slice uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard HLAstandardMIM declarations, standard HLAunicodeString/HLAvariableArray encodings, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, base FOM, standard MIM, additional FOM module, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration when applicable. It checks active ordinary discovery and reflection of HLAmanager.HLAfederate, the reflected federate handle/name/type, a non-empty required HLAfederateHost Unicode value, Join-scoped HLAFOMmoduleDesignatorList, known-object value requests, public object-class/name lookups, and object removal on resignation. It does not assert platform-specific hostname spelling or execution location, filesystem reports, RTI-version values, private snapshots, provider registries, Umbra headers, or an RTI-originated producer handle.

api_surfaces.owner: IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and IEEE 1516.2 standard MIM
